content.value_statement: Belgian nonprofits must coordinate governance documents, ownership reporting, and filing obligations. This public guide helps an AI assistant draft administrative material for professional review.
actual_capabilities: Provides context for AI-assisted drafting of Belgian vzw/asbl bylaws under the WVV.
Outlines meeting notice and minutes drafting for General Assemblies and boards.
Identifies UBO filing, update, and annual confirmation tasks for checklist preparation.
Names court registry and Belgian Official Gazette filing routes, including Forms I and II.
Introduces simplified versus double-entry bookkeeping assessment as a review topic.
Includes a short Dutch General Assembly minutes example.
limitations: Only a public Markdown guide is included; the original scripts, extension source, and document templates are absent.
It cannot submit filings through MyMinfin, the UBO register, a notary, or the court registry.
Legal claims reference 2024–2026 rules without supplied authoritative sources; verify current requirements independently.
It provides no executable accounting assessment tool or guarantee of legally valid documents.

use_cases.title: Prepare Meeting Records
use_cases.description: Draft General Assembly minutes from supplied resolutions, attendance, and voting results, with missing information clearly marked.

use_cases.title: Structure Formation Documents
use_cases.description: Prepare a bylaw outline and identify clauses requiring confirmation against current Belgian law.

use_cases.title: Organize Compliance Review
use_cases.description: Create a review checklist covering UBO confirmations, publication tasks, and accounting questions for qualified professionals.

prompt_templates.title: List Administrative Topics
prompt_templates.prompt: List the Belgian vzw administration topics covered by this guide. Separate drafting assistance from tasks requiring external submission or professional advice.

prompt_templates.title: Draft Meeting Minutes
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft General Assembly minutes using these notes: [notes]. Mark missing attendance, voting, and date details. Do not invent approvals or financial conclusions.

prompt_templates.title: Outline Nonprofit Bylaws
prompt_templates.prompt: Outline bylaws for this Belgian vzw: [purpose, activities, governance]. Flag required legal checks and distinguish the disinterested purpose from activities.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Compliance Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Using [organization facts], prepare a UBO, filing, and bookkeeping review checklist. Request missing evidence and current authoritative sources before making legal conclusions.

output_examples.input: Draft minutes for an assembly that approved the 2025 accounts and granted board discharge. Attendance and vote counts are not supplied.
output: Attendance and quorum: [confirm attendees, representation, and applicable quorum].
2025 accounts: approval reported; record the exact resolution and vote counts.
Board discharge: approval reported; confirm the resolution, eligible voters, and vote counts before finalization.

output_examples.input: Prepare a UBO administration checklist for our Belgian nonprofit.
output: Confirm the persons reportable under current UBO rules with an authorized advisor.
Review recorded details and supporting evidence through the official reporting process.
Check applicable update deadlines and annual confirmation requirements against current official guidance.
Assign a responsible officer to complete submission and retain confirmation.

best_practices: Check legal thresholds, notice periods, and filing requirements against current official Belgian sources.
Use placeholders for personal data until necessary details can be handled through approved channels.
Have a qualified advisor review drafts and an authorized officer complete official submissions.
anti_patterns: Treating generated drafts as guaranteed legal advice or proof of compliance.
Assuming the guide includes working scripts, complete templates, or filing integrations.
Inferring accounting eligibility or valid voting outcomes from incomplete organization data.

faq.question: What is included in this skill?
faq.answer: The reviewed package contains one public Markdown guide with administrative topics and a short meeting minutes example.

faq.question: Does it submit UBO or court registry filings?
faq.answer: No. It describes filing topics but provides no submission integration or direct filing service.

faq.question: Does it include the original scripts and templates?
faq.answer: No. The guide explicitly states that scripts, extension source, and templates from the original package are not included.

faq.question: Are its legal and accounting claims verified?
faq.answer: No independent verification is supplied. Confirm current rules and thresholds using official sources and qualified advice.

faq.question: Which organizations does it address?
faq.answer: It focuses on Belgian vzw/asbl nonprofit administration under the WVV, not other countries or organizational forms.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude or Codex?
faq.answer: It can provide text guidance to Claude, Codex, and Claude Code. The reviewed package has no bundled executable automation.
